div.div: The signal chain moved the result more than the model did: cheap preprocessing, features whose scale does not depend on the room, then any small classifier
PREPROCESSING [B1] - every step is a median, a norm or a moving average

Raw CSI report
one frame: |H| per
subcarrier, with a
real timestamp [A2]

1 Power-normalise
divide by L2 norm
(removes AGC gain
jumps)

2 Drop bad
subcarriers
guard-adjacent,
very low amplitude

3 Background
moving average per
subcarrier = static
channel

4 Dynamics
amplitude minus
background = the
motion part [A1]

5 Energy series
L2 norm of the
dynamics: one
number per report

6 Hampel filter
flag if > 3 x 1.4826 MAD
from the median of
+/-10 reports [1][2][3]

7 Replace
flagged reports
with the window
median

8 Smooth
(optional)
exponential
moving average
FEATURES [B2] and CLASSIFIER [B3] - one window on one link at a time

Window
K subcarriers x L reports
on one link
illustrative 1 s or 4 s [4][5]
ACF (lag 1, averaged over subcarriers): ~1 when still, falls toward 0 with motion; lies in [-1, 1] in every room
PCA eigenvalues of the K x K covariance: still = one dominant eigenvalue; motion spreads energy to the 2nd and later
FFT per subcarrier, DC bin REMOVED (it encodes the room) and the top third of bins dropped as noise [6]

Classifier ladder [B3]
- threshold on one feature
- SVM (RBF kernel)
- small MLP on FFT features, illustrative 128 + 32 hidden units [7]
- (sequence / CNN models: too little data)
Score -> threshold set by the false-alarm budget [C1]

Per-link, per-window motion probability
-> fused across all links of the home [B4]
Group adjacent subcarriers (Ng = 4; 802.11 uses Ng in 1/2/4 [8]): NO loss, 4x less data. Adjacent subcarriers are strongly correlated [B1].
Keep only the top 10% of subcarriers [9] by mean amplitude: about 4 TPR points lost, about 90% of feature compute saved [10] (illustrative).
DO NOT resample to a uniform time grid: interpolation manufactured smooth samples where reports were missing and clearly hurt detection. Use real timestamps [B1, A2].
Phase: random offsets per report. Sanitise only with 2+ receive antennas (linear fit, conjugate product, CSI ratio). A single-stream link uses amplitude only [A2, B1].

What the studies showed (ILLUSTRATIVE values, direction is the lesson):
- preprocessing raised average TPR by about 10 points, and by about 30 points in the hardest scenarios (room with no device, small motion, near the AP) [11]
- single link, TPR at 1% FPR: variance 0.4, ACF lag 1 0.65 [12]; FFT + small net 0.6 [13]

How the result must be tested (ILLUSTRATIVE):
- same features and classifier: 0.9 accuracy on a random split, 0.6 on an unseen day [14][15] - split by time and by home, never at random [B3]
- leave-one-home-out: best home 0.95 TPR, worst home 0.05 [16] - the home is the unit of generalisation

Legend: grey = input / window | blue = preprocessing step (red-outlined cards = traps) | green = room-independent feature, green panel = evidence | purple = classifier | amber = output | red panel = evaluation trap. [A1]-[C1] = kit notes; [n] = constants.json entries below.

Numbers (all loaded from constants.json):
[1] hampel_threshold_typical - public; conventional Hampel threshold (Pearson 2002; MATLAB hampel default)
[2] hampel_mad_scale - public; Hampel filter / MAD consistency constant for Gaussian data (Pearson, IEEE Trans. Control Syst. Technol. 2002)
[3] hampel_halfwidth_illustrative - ILLUSTRATIVE; illustrative Hampel neighbourhood; internal I7
[4] window_short_illustrative - ILLUSTRATIVE; round analysis window used in early single-link work; internal I1/I2
[5] window_long_illustrative - ILLUSTRATIVE; round analysis window used in later feature studies; internal I7
[6] fft_high_freq_drop_illustrative - ILLUSTRATIVE; illustrative: the top third of frequency bins was discarded as noise-dominated; internal I7
[7] mlp_hidden_units_illustrative - ILLUSTRATIVE; illustrative small MLP on concatenated FFT features; internal I7
[8] beamforming_grouping_ng - public; IEEE 802.11n/ac compressed beamforming feedback, grouping parameter Ng
[9] subcarrier_keep_fraction_illustrative - ILLUSTRATIVE; illustrative 'top 10%' selection; internal I7
[10] subcarrier_selection_cost_illustrative - ILLUSTRATIVE; illustrative relation: keeping 10% of subcarriers costs a few TPR points and saves about 90% of feature compute; internal I7
[11] preprocessing_gain_illustrative - ILLUSTRATIVE; illustrative order of the event-level gain from the preprocessing chain, average vs hardest scenario; internal I7
[12] acf_vs_variance_illustrative - ILLUSTRATIVE; illustrative gap between a self-normalised ACF feature and raw variance; internal I7
[13] single_feature_tpr_illustrative - ILLUSTRATIVE; illustrative ordering of single-link features; internal I7 feature comparison
[14] split_random_accuracy_illustrative - ILLUSTRATIVE; illustrative accuracy on a random train/test split of the same days; internal I2
[15] split_heldout_day_accuracy_illustrative - ILLUSTRATIVE; illustrative accuracy when testing on an unseen day; internal I2
[16] home_spread_illustrative - ILLUSTRATIVE; illustrative spread for a simple ACF+variance+SVM detector in leave-one-home-out tests; internal I7
Notes: [A1] multipath; [A2] hardware; [B1] preprocessing; [B2] features; [B3] classifiers and windows; [B4] joint detection; [C1] KPIs. Public refs: Hampel 1974, Pearson 2002 (Hampel/MAD); Zhang et al. 2018-2019 (ACF); Wang et al. 2015 (CARM, PCA); Kotaru et al. 2015, Li et al. 2017, Zeng et al. 2019 (phase); Cortes and Vapnik 1995 (SVM).
